task: Implement signed workspace resolution for review_run_start and story_resolve so wrapper-root projects can explicitly bind git-backed review evidence.
outcome: User sees review_run_start either start a reviewer run against the real git-backed signed workspace or fail with a clear message: metadataRoot is non-git and needs gitRoot or story worktree attachment; story_resolve JSON shows metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, resolved, and unresolvedReason.
facts: B-ab43 documented the required metadataRoot versus signedWorkspaceRoot contract and the need for explicit gitRoot or worktree binding.
Current resolveStoryCommandWorkspace signs ctx.root when no story worktree exists, which fails for non-git wrapper roots and cannot express split roots.
Current story_resolve reports configuredWorktree or ctx.root as authoritativeCwd and lacks signedWorkspaceRoot/resolved/unresolvedReason fields.
review_run_start currently captures HEAD/materialHash and scope diff from workspace.snapshotRoot, then writes local non-authority reviewer-run metadata.
Lattice CLI local reviewer evidence is not an Authority Server receipt and must not set production completion fields.
constraints: Do not auto-discover nested git repositories.
Preserve direct REVIEW compatibility for normal git-backed project roots.
Keep Authority Server completion receipt-backed and separate from local CLI reviewer evidence.
